words: A bonus given on Livechat to a Tier 3 or Tier V player who complains about losing and stays upset after first-level handling. Not every complaint earns one.
The player's bonus budget. Tier 3 gets 3% of their lifetime P&L, Tier V gets 5%. Bonuses are paid out of this balance.
The player's profit or loss over last week. It must be a loss (negative) for compensation.
Compensation can never be more than SW x 40%.
What you do before any bonus: explain luck, guide to the Jackpot, guide to the current activities.
The total valid bet amount. 1x means the player must bet the credit once before withdrawing.
Giving a player two rewards on the same day. Not allowed.

tour.label: When
tour.title: Does this case go to reward assessment?
items: It is a strong complaint, not a general question
You did first-level handling (luck, Jackpot, activities) and no bonus
The player keeps asking and the emotion does not come down
tour.done: All three: check the data (next cards).
tour.notYet: General inquiry: do not give. Mild complaint: soothe. No bonus at this stage.

tour.label: Do
tour.title: Eight steps, in this order
items: Read the emotion
General inquiry: do not give. Mild: soothe. Strong: go on.
First-level handling
Explain luck, guide to the Jackpot and activities. No bonus.
Decide
Only if they keep asking and stay upset, go to reward assessment.
Check the data
Last week P&L negative? No compensation yet this week? SW enough?
Size
Find last week's loss on the ladder. The bonus must be at or below SW x 40%.
ATL approval
Send the case and the amount to the ATL. Issue only after approval.
Issue and message
Kind message, state validity, 1x turnover.
Record
Mark Livechat Compensation Given and note the complaint type. Ticket query VVIP Complain player.

tour.label: Never
tour.title: Six hard stops
items: Give a bonus on the first ask. First-level handling comes first.
Compensate a player whose last week P&L is not a loss.
Give it twice in the same week.
Go above SW x 40%, or give it when the SW is not enough.
Promise a credit you cannot confirm. Say "let me check" first.
Issue a compensation before the ATL approves it.

tour.label: Approver
tour.title: Can you issue it now?
tour.q: Has the ATL approved this compensation?
tour.yes: Issue it: kind message, state the validity, 1x turnover. Then record and tag.
tour.no: Do not issue. Every compensation needs ATL approval first, whatever the amount.

pool.q: An angry player says they lost everything today. What do you do first?
pool.why: Emotion first. Acknowledge the feeling before any solution, check or redirect.

pool.q: A player asks for free credit every day with no qualifying reason. What do you do?
o: Give it to keep them happy
Decline gently and redirect to a game
pool.why: Decline gently, redirect to a game, and say you will let them know by SMS when there is something. They should still feel looked after.

pool.q: You are not sure the player qualifies for a credit. What do you tell them?
pool.why: Never promise a bonus you cannot deliver. Say "let me check" instead of a false commitment.

pool.q: The player qualifies for compensation but already got a Reload today. What do you do?
pool.why: No stacking with a same-day reward.

pool.q: You issued a compensation credit. What must the record show?
o: Player, reason, amount, tier and who issued it
pool.why: Log player, reason, amount, tier and who issued it, and tag the case. No record means an unverifiable credit.

pool.q: A player says they lost a lot and asks for a bonus. It is the first time they ask. What do you do?
o: Do first-level handling: luck, Jackpot, activities. No bonus yet
pool.why: First-level handling is mandatory. Only if they keep asking and stay upset do you go to reward assessment.

pool.q: A player just asks if there is any bonus today, calmly. Compensation?
o: No, a general inquiry gets no bonus
pool.why: General inquiry: do not give. Compensation is only for a strong complaint after first-level handling.

pool.q: Strong complaint, still upset after first-level handling. Last week P&L is +RM 1,500. What do you do?
o: No compensation: last week was not a loss
pool.why: Last week P&L must be negative. A player who was up last week cannot be compensated.

pool.q: The player got compensation on Monday. On Thursday they complain again and qualify. What do you do?
pool.why: Check whether compensation was already received this week. If it was, it cannot be given again.

pool.q: Last week loss RM 8,000 (ladder RM 98). SW is RM 200, so SW x 40% = RM 80. What do you give?
pool.why: Never go above SW x 40%. The highest ladder row at or below RM 80 is RM 78.

pool.q: The compensation is only RM 18 and passes every check. Can you issue it yourself?
o: No, the ATL approves every compensation
pool.why: Every Livechat Compensation is ATL-approved before issuance, whatever the amount.
